title: BOTH SIDES
lesson: Hear both sides before you judge
caption: Judging someone before hearing their side? THE RULE BOOK Ep 19: Clyde accused the waiter of stealing his croissant. He was sitting on it. Then Ruva said S betrayed her dad, and Solo walked in. What does Solo want? A) To say sorry B) The pages C) To join us. A, B or C? Send this to your Clyde. #liferules #friendship #stickman

lines.tr: QUI A VOLÉ MON CROISSANT ? AVOUE !

lines: MONSIEUR... YOU ARE SITTING ON IT.
S WAS DAD'S PARTNER. HE BETRAYED HIM.

lines.tr: S ÉTAIT L'ASSOCIÉ DE PAPA. IL L'A TRAHI.

lines: SO S IS THE VILLAIN. NO CAP.

lines.tr: ALORS S EST LE MÉCHANT. SANS MENTIR.

lines: YOU BLAMED A WAITER. YOU SAT ON IT.

lines.tr: TU AS ACCUSÉ UN SERVEUR. TU ÉTAIS ASSIS DESSUS.

lines: HEAR BOTH SIDES BEFORE YOU JUDGE.

lines.tr: ÉCOUTE LES DEUX CÔTÉS AVANT DE JUGER.

lines: ORDER THREE COFFEES. THIS GETS LONG.

lines.tr: COMMANDE TROIS CAFÉS. ÇA VA ÊTRE LONG.
